# Golden IFC corpus

Round-trip fixtures for `scripts/golden-roundtrip.mjs` (CI workflow
`.github/workflows/golden-roundtrip.yml`). The harness parses every `*.ifc`
file in this folder twice, diffs entity-class counts, and compares the result
against the golden snapshot in `snapshots/<file>.ifc.json`. A mismatch fails CI.

## Current state (2026-11-15)

The corpus now contains **5 self-authored valid fixtures** generated by
`scripts/generate-ifc-corpus.mjs` (extends `scripts/generate-ifc.mjs`), plus
**4 invalid-model fixtures** consumed by `test:ifc-semantics` and the fuzz
gate `test:fuzz-ifc`:

| Fixture | Schema | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `generated-small.ifc` | IFC4 | 2 walls + 1 door (hosted opening) + 1 slab |
| `generated-2x3.ifc` | IFC2X3 | same model, IFC2X3 schema |
| `generated-structural.ifc` | IFC4 | 1 beam + 1 column |
| `mep-model.ifc` | IFC4 | 2 ducts + pipe + cable tray + conduit + AHU equipment, 2 storeys |
| `arch-classified.ifc` | IFC4 | arch model + Uniclass-style classifications (4 elements) |
| `invalid/bad-guid.ifc` | IFC4 | GlobalId outside the base64 alphabet |
| `invalid/dangling-ref.ifc` | IFC4 | relationship references a missing entity |
| `invalid/missing-units.ifc` | IFC4 | unit assignment removed |
| `invalid/truncated.ifc` | IFC4 | file cut mid-DATA |

All valid fixtures are generated from the platform's own authoring writer —
no third-party license constraints. `node scripts/golden-roundtrip.mjs`
reports `5/5 pass`. The `invalid/` subtree is intentionally not scanned by
the golden gate. See `docs/IFC_COMPATIBILITY_MATRIX.md` for the capability
matrix these fixtures back.
